Fix slug generation so leading/trailing whitespace never creates leading/trailing hyphens. Preserve lowercase conversion and collapse runs of interior whitespace to one hyphen.
Fix the CLI entry point so callers can pass either a single customer string or a one-element argv list. When arguments are omitted, keep reading the first command-line argument as before.
Fix the numeric-parts joiner so nonnumeric labels are preserved rather than rendered as NaN. Keep existing padding for numeric parts, including zero.
Add an optional discount field to invoices, default zero, preserving existing constructor arguments. Subtract the discount in the invoice total so billing taxes the discounted subtotal.
Wire the client's optional constructor timeout to fetch via an AbortSignal. Only add a signal when a timeout is supplied; keep the existing method and headers.
Allow the async bulk rate lookup to forward a requested default tax rate to the existing per-region lookup. Keep the existing default and environment override behavior.
